title: Fine-Grained Interpretation of Political Opinions in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting fine-grained political concept vectors from LLM internal representations using representation engineering techniques (CAA, RepE, and Linear Probing) on a custom dataset of left- and right-leaning statements across economic, diplomatic, civil, and societal dimensions. The bias is evaluated via detection tasks (classifying the political leaning of the model's hidden states) and intervention tasks (steering the model's generation toward specific political leanings).
